title: UI JS
description: JavaScript a page links, served at a versioned URL.

rbac_context.description: The context the item's write is authorized in on its branch.

branch.description: The name of the branch the item is on; main when absent.

deleted.description: true: a deletion marker, hiding the base's JS of this name on this branch. It needs only a name.

base.description: Server-managed: the ETag of the parent branch's JS this one overrides, or null.

name.description: The JS item's name, unique on its branch.

js.description: The JavaScript text. It may not contain "</script".

order.description: Items are linked in order, then by name.
